# Xinyuan Liu

> Xinyuan Liu is a computer science PhD student at Arizona State University (LENS Lab), advised by Ransalu Senanayake. She works on information-efficient AI systems: online LLM selection and routing, cognitive evaluation of humanoid robots, LLM orchestration of multi-robot systems, and imitation learning for embodied agents.
> Contact: xinyua11@asu.edu

## Research focus

- Online LLM selection and routing from limited preference feedback
- Cognitive and human-factors evaluation of humanoid robots
- LLM orchestration of multi-robot crews with enforced execution contracts
- Imitation learning and behavior cloning for embodied agents
- Multimodal learning for surgical and medical systems

## Publications

- [Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/physical-agentic-ai/) — arXiv preprint, 2026. An LLM plans for a crew of robots while a procedural orchestrator, checking declarative workflow contracts at dispatch time, keeps sole authority to act; demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid and Go2 quadruped. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Riana Chatterjee, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/cupid/) — International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026. A dueling-bandit framework that efficiently matches each user to the right LLM from pairwise preference feedback, under cost and time budgets. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/llm-routing-maxsat/) — ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. LLM routing under natural-language feedback cast as weighted MaxSAT, with feedback turned into hard and soft constraints over model attributes. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [Humanoid Factors: Design Principles for AI Humanoids in Human Worlds](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/humanoid-factors/) — arXiv preprint, 2026. A framework of physical, cognitive, social and ethical humanoid factors for designing and evaluating humanoids that share human spaces. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Ransalu Senanayake, Lixiao Huang.
- [Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/neural-augmented-kelvinlet/) — AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2026. Kelvinlet analytical priors combined with large-scale FEM data make real-time neural soft-tissue simulation more accurate and physically plausible. Authors: Ashkan Shahbazi*, Kyvia Pereira*, Jon S. Heiselman, Elaheh Akbari, Annie Benson, Sepehr Seifi, Xinyuan Liu, Garrison L. H. Johnston, Jie Ying Wu, Nabil Simaan, Michael Miga, Soheil Kolouri.

(* denotes equal contribution.)
